meta.name: The Dirty South
meta.description: Sue Parker is thrust into a desperate struggle to rescue her family's failing business, teetering on the edge of ruin due to her father's negligence. With the arrival of a charming wanderer, she sees him as their sole hope to help prevent their bar from being seized by the merciless local tycoon.
meta.slogan: Out of patience, out of time, and now she's a criminal.
